queries.name: marketplace-registry-options
queries.intent: Provide distinct authorized registry choices from resolved package records.
queries.objective: List the registry choices available in the current authorized marketplace package projection.
queries.acceptance: Return distinct registry IDs and names with package counts from resolved records; missing or inaccessible registries must not be inferred from absent rows.

queries.name: marketplace-publisher-options
queries.intent: Provide distinct publisher choices from resolved package records.
queries.objective: List the publisher choices available in the current authorized marketplace package projection.
queries.acceptance: Return distinct publishers with package counts from resolved records; an absent publisher is not proof that its packages do not exist.

queries.name: marketplace-ranked
queries.intent: Order keyword-matched campaign packages by reviewed publisher attestation, public maintenance evidence, local adoption evidence, and public popularity, without treating missing evidence as zero.
queries.objective: Present authorized campaign packages in deterministic discovery order using only observable, governed signals.
queries.acceptance: Rank verified provenance and known maintenance before observed adoption and public stars, break ties by name and ID, and preserve unknown evidence rather than treating it as zero or verified.

queries.name: ingestion-health
queries.intent: Show the current Redis-backed webhook and collection health snapshot.
queries.objective: Determine whether the reported collection, webhook, queue, and backfill state warrants inspecting ingestion diagnostics.
queries.acceptance: Report the observed health, queue, failure, success, and projection timestamps together; verify freshness and configuration before calling collection healthy, and treat missing state as unknown rather than zero.

queries.name: marketplace-package-detail
queries.intent: Expose normalized marketplace package records for source-coordinate lookup by the detail view.
queries.objective: Locate the resolver-produced package record for a source coordinate supplied by the consuming view.
queries.acceptance: Use the returned package-source, registry, ref, and resolved-commit fields when inspecting a matching record; the query itself does not filter by coordinate, and an absent match is not proof of package nonexistence or approval.

queries.name: friction-by-workflow
queries.intent: Rank workflows by observed gh-aw audit friction AI Credit totals for investigation.
queries.objective: Identify which repository and workflow combinations have the largest measured friction totals in retained observations.
queries.acceptance: Compare friction-aic and distinct runs with the underlying measurement states and attribution evidence; do not equate a ranking with avoidable cost or a validated saving.
queries.description: Total gh-aw audit friction cost grouped by repository and workflow.

queries.name: friction-observations
queries.intent: List retained gh-aw audit friction measurements with their run context and attribution totals.
queries.objective: Trace each reported friction measurement to a run and distinguish counted, suppressed, and unattributed occurrences.
queries.acceptance: Preserve native AIC, total-run AIC, measurement state, timestamps, links, and occurrence counts; missing or unattributed evidence remains uncertain, not a verified opportunity for savings.
queries.description: Newest friction measurements first, preserving the native audit values and uncertainty state.

queries.name: indexing-daily-records
queries.intent: Aggregate records committed from CAO Activity by ingestion UTC day.
queries.objective: Expose the observed daily committed-record totals for ingestion diagnostics.
queries.acceptance: Each returned UTC day sums committedRecords from the selected ingestion transaction kinds; absent days or low totals alone do not establish missing source records.

queries.name: indexing-daily-workflow-runs
queries.intent: Aggregate workflow runs ingested from CAO Activity by UTC day.
queries.objective: Expose the observed daily raw-run totals from ingestion transactions.
queries.acceptance: Each returned UTC day sums rawRuns from the selected ingestion transaction kinds; transaction volume is not a count of distinct retained runs or proof of source coverage.

queries.name: indexing-campaigns-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained campaigns rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained campaigns row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result campaigns and count campaign rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected campaign coverage.

queries.name: indexing-repositories-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained repositories rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained repositories row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result repositories and count repository rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected repository coverage.

queries.name: indexing-workflows-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained workflows rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflows row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflows and count workflow rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected workflow coverage.

queries.name: indexing-runs-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained workflow runs rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflow runs row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflow runs and count run rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected execution volume.

queries.name: indexing-domains-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained network domains rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained network domains row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result network domains and count domain event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no network activity.

queries.name: indexing-tools-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained tool events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained tool events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result tool events and count tool event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no tool use.

queries.name: indexing-audits-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained audit events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained audit events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result audit events and count audit event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no audit findings.

queries.name: indexing-issues-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained issue events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained issue events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result issue events and count issue event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no issues exist.

queries.name: indexing-operational-values-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained operational values rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained operational values row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result operational values and count operational-value rows in the current database; absence or zero does not imply zero value or an evaluated outcome.

queries.name: indexing-transactions-table-count
queries.intent: Count retained ingestion transactions rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained ingestion transactions row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result ingestion transactions and count transaction IDs in the current database; absence or zero does not establish whether upstream ingestion ran.

queries.name: indexing-database-table-counts
queries.intent: Count retained canonical dashboard database rows by table.
queries.objective: Compare the retained table row counts to identify tables needing further ingestion or coverage investigation.
queries.acceptance: Union the named table-count projections and report their table labels and counts; check source availability, retention, and separate transaction evidence before interpreting an empty or small table as an ingestion defect.

queries.name: indexing-transactions
queries.intent: Prepare retained ingestion transactions for card presentation.
queries.objective: Expose transaction identity, kind, timestamp, committed-record count, and payload hash for ingestion traceability.
queries.acceptance: Projected fields match retained transactions without implying successful upstream coverage from a committed count or hash alone; missing transactions require a freshness and availability check.

queries.name: engines-models-usage
queries.intent: Summarize run-level AIC and token usage by agent and model identifiers without treating unavailable telemetry as zero.
queries.objective: Locate agent and model combinations whose observed per-run AIC or token usage merits checking against individual runs.
queries.acceptance: Report run counts and native minimum, mean, and maximum values only for reported metrics; inspect underlying runs for per-metric telemetry coverage and context before comparing combinations, and infer neither efficiency nor outcome value from usage alone.
queries.description: Observed workflow runs grouped by agent ID and model ID. Each AIC and token statistic uses only runs that reported that metric.

queries.name: skill-invocations
queries.intent: Select observed skill invocations for skill usage analytics.
queries.objective: Expose skill event identity, scope, invocation counts, and failed counts for downstream usage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed event and its repository/workflow attribution with native counts; missing records or failed counts alone do not establish whether a skill was useful or available.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-skill
queries.intent: Rank skills by their observed invocation count.
queries.objective: Identify skills with the highest observed invocation totals for follow-up inspection.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill and retain the rank as a usage description; do not equate popularity with effectiveness or infer unobserved invocations.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-workflow-totals
queries.intent: Rank workflows by their observed skill invocation count.
queries.objective: Produce repository-scoped workflow invocation totals for downstream skill-usage comparison.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by organization, repository, and workflow; totals describe recorded usage only, not success or expected adoption.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-workflow
queries.intent: Present workflow skill invocation totals with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Expose observed workflow skill invocation totals with a link to inspect each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Each projected workflow coordinate, link, and invocation total traces to the grouped source; using a link to investigate does not establish that usage caused an outcome.

queries.name: skill-workflow-totals
queries.intent: Count observed invocations for each skill and workflow.
queries.objective: Produce skill-by-workflow invocation totals for the downstream inventory.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill, organization, repository, and workflow; missing combinations are not evidence that a skill could not run.

queries.name: skill-workflow-inventory
queries.intent: List observed skills by workflow with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Identify observed skill/workflow combinations and provide a workflow link for inspecting their runs.
queries.acceptance: Show the repository, workflow, skill, link, and observed invocation total from the grouped evidence; an absent row does not prove non-use, and a high count does not prove effectiveness.

queries.name: experiment-assignment-coverage
queries.intent: Count observed run assignments for each experiment and workflow without inferring a completion target.
queries.objective: Expose assignment counts by experiment and workflow for investigating observed experiment coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count retained assignment rows in each experiment/workflow group, not distinct runs; do not invent a target, infer missing assignments from absent groups, or treat assignments as eval or grader outcomes.

queries.name: eval-yes-no-status
queries.intent: Select explicit YES/NO eval answers while retaining unknown results only in the underlying evidence collection.
queries.objective: Expose explicitly answered eval observations for comparison with their underlying run evidence.
queries.acceptance: Return only recorded YES and NO answers; excluded unknowns must not be interpreted as NO, absent evals as YES, or an eval answer as a validated operational outcome.

queries.name: grader-status-ledger
queries.intent: Report explicit grader pass/fail observations without inferring current state from prior runs.
queries.objective: Distinguish explicit per-observation grader pass and fail verdicts from unknown statuses.
queries.acceptance: Map only pass/passed to YES and fail/failed to NO, leaving all other statuses unknown; preserve run-level evidence and do not infer current success, causation, or policy authority from a prior verdict.
